title: Alias Grace

vibeProfile.oneLine: A servant convicted of murder: guilty, mad, or wronged? Atwood won't say.

summary: Based on a real 1843 case, Atwood's novel imagines the inner life of Grace Marks, a young Irish servant convicted of a notorious double murder in Canada, as a doctor tries to unlock her buried memories and decide whether she is guilty, mad, or wronged. Ambiguous to the end, it is a masterful historical mystery about memory, class, madness and the stories women are allowed to tell. Rich, unsettling and impossible to resolve, in the best way.
whyReadIt: A gripping historical mystery that never lets you be sure of the truth. Atwood spinning a real murder into something haunting.

funFacts.text: It is based on the real, unresolved 1843 murder case of Grace Marks in Upper Canada.
